question: Which of the following states registered the highest growth rate in population during 2001 - 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census 2011, **Meghalaya has recorded the highest inter-annual growth rate during 2001–11, i.e., 27.80%.**
 
• According to details from the 2011 Census, Meghalaya has a **population of 29.67 lakhs, an increase from the figure of 23.19 lakhs in the 2001 census.**
 
• The total population of Meghalaya according to the 2011 census is** 2,966,889, of which male and female are 1,491,832 and 1,475,057 respectively.**
 
• In the year 2001, total population of Meghalaya was** 2,318,822 **in which males were **1,176,087 while females were 1,142,735.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Total population of **Maharashtra** according to 2011 census is **112,374,333 of which male and female are 58,243,056 and 54,131,277 respectively.**
 
• **Kerala's** population according to census 2011 is **3,33,87,677, with 1,60,21,290 males and 1,73,66,387 females.**
 
• The Population of **Rajasthan** as per the 2011 census stands at about** 68 million, making it the 8th most populated state in India. ​ **
 
• A population census provides the government with a suggestion of the distinct population in distinct parts of the country, which will in turn support the government in the adequate provision of social services such as **housing, water, electricity, roads, schools, and hospitals, which are beneficial to the citizens of the country.**
